info.name: E-Learning Platform API (Production & Dashboard)
info.description:
Complete, production-ready Postman collection for E-Learning API.

### Features:
- Modular feature-wise organization
- Dedicated Admin Dashboard suite
- Automated JWT Token Management for both Student & Admin
- Dynamic variable capture for testId, sessionId, facultyId, etc.
- Pre-configured headers, query parameters, and JSON / Form-Data payloads

request.description: Verify server health and availability.
Get root welcome page.
Simulates inbound Stripe Webhook events. Requires valid stripe-signature when called against live Stripe secret.

item.name: 01. Authentication & Security
item.description: User registration, login, OTP verification, password reset, and automatic token management.

request.description: Register a new student account. Password requires 1 uppercase, 1 lowercase, 1 number, 1 special character.
Login as student. On success, automatically saves accessToken to {{token}} and refreshToken to {{refreshToken}}.

exec: console.log("Student Access Token successfully saved to {{token}}!");

request.description: Login as Administrator / Super Admin. On success, automatically saves accessToken to {{adminToken}} and refreshToken to {{adminRefreshToken}}.

exec: console.log("Admin Access Token successfully saved to {{adminToken}}!");

request.description: Login using Google or Apple OAuth token.
Verify 6-digit email OTP after registration. Automatically sets token.
Resend email verification code.
Trigger a password reset OTP to email.
Resend password reset OTP.
Verify password reset OTP before setting a new password.
Set a new password after OTP verification.
Change current account password while authenticated.
Exchange refresh token for new access token.
Exchange admin refresh token for new access token.
